summary: States that Ansible settings can also be set with environment variables, which override the matching config file settings, and points to the reference lists for core and collection plugin variables.
questions: Can I configure Ansible with environment variables instead of ansible.cfg?
Which wins, an environment variable or ansible.cfg?
Where's the list of ANSIBLE_ environment variables?

answer_card.title: Configure Ansible with environment variables
answer_card.answer_md: Yes. Ansible settings can be set through environment variables, and when set they **override** the matching settings from the configuration file. Full lists are in the configuration settings reference (core) and the list of collection environment variables (plugins in collections).
